sourceRefs.needle: //! Thin browser adapter over the same owner used for authentication.
//! Exact native batch HTTP scopes and current authorized read-first recovery.
//! Explicit reviewed native atomic batch scope. No accounting calculations or caller identity.
//! One current control authorization and ONE company IMMEDIATE transaction for an entire batch.
//! Native atomic_v1 batches.
//! Source-shaped filtered workbench over the SAME complete native plan/universe.
//! Mandatory current native readers; no injected success callbacks or whole-year substitution.
mod mileage_posting;
//! One explicit transport join before every existing CLI dispatcher; no server lifecycle.
use rentemester_client::{
//! Source-backed argv structure only. Family adapters own allowed flags and domain types.
use rentemester_client::{
//! Flat source argv; native cookie authority and atomic receipts remain authoritative.
//! Exact reviewed batch transport. Server owns source proofs, policy, money and authority.
//! Six source operations over the unchanged native atomic batch transport.
result["providerReference"] = raw
//! Reviewed purchase-rule proofs. No VAT calculation, journal write or implied fallback.
//! Immutable extraction history on an admitted caller transaction. Namespace physical proof belongs to the host.
//! Internal admitted-connection orchestration, not a product writer or authentication provider.

binary.representation: JSON only; no selected binary producer.

paginationFilterOrder.order: Source order retained; no invented generic pagination.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.authority: Current MFA-enabled/email-verified human session and current workspace/company permission, immutable server attribution; no caller actor override. Batch Plan/Status/Workbench CompanyRead; Persist CompanyDraftWrite; Approve CompanyReview; Apply CompanyLedgerPost. Exception list CompanyRead, resolve CompanyReview. Read dashboards/integrity/obligations/multi-year current CompanyRead. Current Owner namespace and supported installed schemas, immediate control and company transactions, backup/transfer write fences, current physical original/source hashes, period and posting horizon checks retained. Batch ready purchase sources verified before persist/approve/apply. No fresh-MFA requirement invented for Current-session leaves. Service usage admission/finalization and failed business stages remain distinct; reads/plans/refusals may write control metadata. SQL commit is not file publication, missing result/permission loss is not rollback.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: Direct HTTP inner confirm:true persist/approve/apply; SDK object-only preflight plus explicit confirm. CLI original --confirm yes for persist/dry-run/approve/apply; optional actor equality requires current api.me subject, never override. Native remote bare --confirm plus inner true. MCP overloaded original flat confirm boolean false produces CONFIRM_REQUIRED; native outer false SDK invalid_input. Independent human reviewer cannot be planner; apply may be current authorized poster with valid independent approval. Source availability/review/period/scanner/FX/account/complete candidate proofs remain current.

key.name: runKey (persist/durable dry-run only); exact runId+planHash for approve/apply

retry.scope: Selected company ledger; exact four scope dates, selected companyId assertion, current human authority, immutable reviewed revision/candidate universe and source evidence. runKey exact (spaces retained), not HTTP idempotency header. Approval binds independent reviewer subject; apply requires an approval independent of planner.
retry.ttl: No expiry/TTL implemented; durable append-only rows retained with ledger and verified backups.
retry.tombstone: No generic expiry/tombstone protocol; legacy unversioned history is inspect-only, never resumed.
retry.naturalDedup: Persist same runKey only after recomputing exact current plan and expectedPlanHash; conflicts refuse. Approval same revision/current reviewer returns existing only after current source equality. Apply explicit exact revision may return duplicate only after verifying real immutable receipts, completed attempt/four successful checks and current bank relations; not a blind replay or partial resume. All ready item posting/rule/VAT/reconciliation/dimension receipts and final checks one company transaction; failure aborts whole atomic_v1 operation.
retry.readBack: Read canonical runs/{runId}, or runs?runKey=EXACT when persist result is missing. Compare immutable revisions, planner/reviewer, attempts, item receipts, four finalChecks, journal/bank/source proofs before deliberate further action. Reconciliation is read-back, not retry.
retry.unresolvedProvider: No provider approval or automatic provider/posting retry. Failed commit/control finalization/restore/current authority can leave unknown; absence of readable result is not absence of effect. Verified backup restore retains receipt/source integrity; legacy partial batches never resumed.

input.preprocessors: main local_binding::prepare runs before dispatch and consumes split/attached global --local-profile until --; duplicate/mixed server/loopback options refuse. Profile private Unix socket with exact origin, no TCP fallback or server lifecycle. Original company paths only verified profile equality, no ambient company. Remote recognized flags are NOT necessarily accepted: source/report/format, audit/source/backup/login/service/dimension guards precede selected leaves. Remote values are split only; original_args accepts split or attached values. No generated actor/key/hash/date.

success.stdout: Native JSON compact plus newline; original batch compact JSON or human banner+pretty native core; original exceptions pretty JSON or exact Danish human renderer. Help/discovery handled separately; no HTTP call.
success.correlation: Native outer ok=data.ok default true; HTTP200 businessfalse remains failed envelope with nested data, not SDK error. MCP text parses to structuredContent, isError=(outer ok!=true); RPC result id echoes bounded request id. Original batch removes core ok/errors, keeps remaining data; persist removes dryRun, dry_run retains. Status preserves native data.ok. Original exceptions lifts ok/errors/code/appliedRules and only success has data; resolve data.resolved can be false without tool failure.

refusal.transport: Batch SDK retains parsed non2xx ok:false with nonempty code, except write5xx/408 or uncertain codes become OutcomeUnknown; source adapter validates success identities and stored plan JSON/hash, write malformed success unknown; persist removes dryRun. Native exception general SDK discards422 body into server_refused; write5xx/failed read/malformed body unknown. Original exception retains ONLY validated422 flat business refusal; malformed422 remains server_refused422. Original success safe integer row validation is narrower than raw native i64 IDs. HTML SDK retains parsed non2xx businessfalse, otherwise status refusal; successful MIME/filename/header/date/bytes bounded and validated. Native CLI returns {ok:false,data:core} when HTTP core businessfalse, not generic SDK wrapper. Original MCP error uses errors[] and code, native error nested error{code,message,status?}. Missing original batch confirm:false yields CONFIRM_REQUIRED tool error; native outer confirm:false is SDK invalid_input; exception resolve absent/false confirm is CONFIRM_REQUIRED business tool result.

parseProtocol.guards: main local_binding::prepare runs before dispatch and consumes split/attached global --local-profile until --; duplicate/mixed server/loopback options refuse. Profile private Unix socket with exact origin, no TCP fallback or server lifecycle. Original company paths only verified profile equality, no ambient company. Remote recognized flags are NOT necessarily accepted: source/report/format, audit/source/backup/login/service/dimension guards precede selected leaves. Remote values are split only; original_args accepts split or attached values. No generated actor/key/hash/date.
parseProtocol.CLI: Native remote errors are compact JSON stdout newline exit1/2, stderr empty. Original batch exit2 stderr invalid_input: MESSAGE newline even JSON mode; JSON exit0/1 compact stdout, human success stdout and refusal stderr with Bookkeeping batch succeeded/refused or outcome unknown banner plus pretty native core. Original exceptions usage2 stderr raw message newline; JSON success/refusal0/1 pretty stdout; human list Danish queue, human resolve success ✔ Markerer en exception som løst.; refusal resolve stderr ✘ Markerer en exception som løst. failed then indented arrows; human list failure raw errors. Original exceptions --format is not validated, json mode is --json or format!=human and nonTTY (so format=json on TTY alone does not force JSON). Original batch --format json|human validated. Batch all four writes --confirm yes, remote bare --confirm plus inner confirm:true; original exception resolve invocation confirms, rejects extra confirm/stdin; MCP requires confirm:true. Remote reads forbid confirm/preview flags. Native --help only remote root exact request; original family/root help discovery main handled before leaf execution. No ignored generic --year/--source/--format/actor aliases.
